items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: And, uh, uh, Joe Segretta was running, running that fish fries at Liberty and Pedida.

ctx.x: I wonder about that. What bands did you play with when you'd be advertising?

Well, it's like I said, I played, when I was playing, I was, when I played with Rene, that's practically most every, every dance he played for outside, dances he had to advertise. People hire, when they hire a band, they hire for the advertising, too, you see. They give you two dollars extra for that advertising. Did Rene ever buck against Louis Armstrong? Oh, Armstrong, practically yes. Well, Armstrong, he didn't, he didn't, didn't much, he didn't do much advertising. Uh-huh. You know, because when Armstrong…
